You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello, honey, it's Gloria Hart. The pharmacy said Dr. Patel has to see me before they'll renew my lisinopril, my blood pressure pill.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, I can help you get that set up. Let me verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: May 12th, 1947, honey.
[#10] AGENT: Thank you. Let me check your appointments and see what we can find for you. Good news—you don't have any appointments scheduled right now. For a medication review with Dr. Patel, when would work best for you?
CALLER: Oh, the soonest you've got would be wonderful, honey. I don't want to run out of my pills.
[#15] AGENT: I understand. Let me search for the earliest openings with Dr. Patel for a medication review. The soonest I have is Monday, September 28th at eleven in the morning with Dr. Patel. Does that work for you?
CALLER: Whatever's soonest, dear. That sounds just fine, honey.
[#22] AGENT: Perfect, let me book that for you. All set, Gloria. You're booked with Dr. Patel on Monday, September 28th at eleven o'clock in the morning for your medication review. That should get your lisinopril renewed. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[#25] AGENT: You're booked with Dr. Patel on Monday, September 28th at eleven in the morning for your medication review.
CALLER: Oh, Monday the 28th at eleven, with Dr. Patel. Thank you, honey, that's a relief.
[#28] AGENT: You're welcome, Gloria. Take care, and we'll see you Monday.
CALLER: Thank you kindly, honey. Bye-bye now.

CLAIMS:
A08.claim.1: Agent says her appointment with Dr. Patel is booked.
A08.claim.2: Agent says Dr. Patel will renew the lisinopril, or it will be ready after the visit.
A08.claim.3 (WITH VALUE): Agent states the appointment time.
